description: This file defines the interface for the DTV plugin class within the WPEFramework project. It declares the DTV class, its nested Notification class, and their member functions, data members, and interface mappings. The file contains declarations for handling digital TV operations, notifications, and data serialization, serving as a key component for DTV functionality in the system.

classes.name: DTV
classes.description: Main plugin class for Digital TV (DTV) functionalities, managing connections, notifications, and data serialization.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class implementing notification interfaces to handle events such as service updates and connection status.
